slides.title: Passive in all tenses and with modals
slides.subtitle: Full passive system
goals: Form the passive in all tenses.
Use passive with modals and infinitives.
Choose the passive for formal writing.

head: Tense
Example
rows: It **must be done** today. It **should have been checked**.
I want **to be told**. I hate **being interrupted**.

items.t: They are building a new hospital. → A new hospital is ___ built.
Someone has stolen my bike. → My bike has ___ stolen.
You must sign the form. → The form must ___ signed.

items.q: I don't like ___ what to do.
